title: The Signature Programming Exercise Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Coding challenges organized by topic and difficulty. The Programming Exercise Database organizes coding challenges by topic and difficulty rank: each exercise states the problem, input-output examples, constraints, and a reference solution kept separate. Difficulty follows the 1-15 teaching ladder. The Signature side adds test-case generators so students can verify solutions beyond the given examples.
capabilities: Organize exercises by topic and ladder difficulty

Keep reference solutions separate from problems
